name: Magazine Cover
tagline: Cover-star portraits with room for your own masthead.
description: Be the cover story of an imaginary business, music, travel, fashion, tech, sports, wellness or food magazine. Every frame is composed with empty headroom for a masthead you add yourself; no real magazine names, logos or text are generated.
negativePrompt: deformed hands, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused fingers, extra limbs, distorted face, asymmetrical eyes, plastic skin, waxy skin, airbrushed skin, cartoon, anime, illustration, 3d render, cgi, painting, watermark, text, logo, signature, blurry, lowres, jpeg artifacts, duplicate person, letters, masthead text, headlines, barcode, magazine logo, captions
